System tables reference

Table Description Supports streaming Free retention period Includes global or regional data
Billable usage
Table path: system.billing.usage		 Includes records for all billable usage across your account. Yes 365 days Global
AI Gateway usage (Beta)
Table path: system.ai_gateway.usage		 Captures request and response details. Yes 365 days Regional
AI Gateway external model spend (Beta)
Table path: system.ai_gateway.external_model_spend 		Records estimated USD spend. No 365 days Regional
Model serving endpoint usage (Public Preview)
Table path: system.serving.endpoint_usage 		Captures token counts. Yes 90 days Regional
Pricing
Table path: system.billing.list_prices		 A historical log of SKU pricing. No Indefinite Global

Known issues

New columns may be added to existing system tables at any time. Existing columns will not change or be removed.

No support for real-time monitoring. Data is updated throughout the day.
